hero.headline: Built for sellers
hero.body: Stallio started with one observation: World's best sellers were already selling on Instagram and WhatsApp. They just needed a real store to match. We built exactly that.

mission.quote2: We built the store for that.
mission.body: We're not building a marketplace. We're building the simplest, most powerful store a solo seller can run from their phone, because that's where real commerce actually happens.

story.title: Why we built Stallio
story.p1: We watched talented sellers spend their days copy-pasting product details into WhatsApp DMs, tracking orders in handwritten notebooks, and losing buyers to a checkout process that didn't exist.
story.p2: The tools they had were built for warehouses, not for someone running a boutique from their phone. So, we built Stallio — a store that lives at a single link and fits the way social selling actually works.
story.p3: No domains to configure. No payment gateways to negotiate. Just your products, your buyers, and one link you share everywhere.

items.title: Speed over ceremony
items.desc: If it takes more than a minute to set up, we rethink it. Every screen, every step.

items.title: Sellers keep control
items.desc: Your payments, your buyers, your data. We stay out of the middle, always.

items.title: Built for this market
items.desc: Designed for how social commerce actually works.

items.title: Mobile first, always
items.desc: Your buyers are on their phones. So is every pixel, every interaction we write.

card1.title:
Home kitchens, studios,
and side hustles.
card1.body: Not enterprise procurement. Stallio is designed for the seller who runs their business from their phone and ships every day.

card2.title:
Straightforward
by design
card2.body: Fewer knobs and plugins. A clear path from catalog to order.

card3.title: Room to grow
card3.body: Start small, add products and polish as your audience grows with you.

card4.title: Whether you're testing a new line or shipping every week
card4.body: Stallio is meant to stay out of the way. Update products, tweak copy, and keep selling without rebuilding a whole site.

card5.title: Independent sellers deserve tools that feel premium and honest.
card5.body: Clear pricing, clear fulfillment, and a storefront that respects the buyer's time as much as yours.
